discourse.title: The Ultimate Attainment
discourse.excerpt: When man acts on earth the way he speaks He is no longer man, he is a noble soul When man doesn't act the way he speaks He is no longer man, he is only a beast. Every deed is a seed that inevitably yields fruits, either sweet or bitter, which one has to eat in joy or grief. So, man has to resolve to do good, see good, hear good and be good.
discourse.theme: Let thought, word, and deed be one — do good, see good, hear good, be good.

reflection: Here is Swami's simplest test of a human being: do you act the way you speak? If yes, you are a noble soul; if not, something less than human is steering you. Every deed is a seed, He says, and you will eat its fruit — sweet or bitter. So make today's resolution small and exact: one kind thought, one true word, one good deed. Thought, word, deed — let them be one. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15, 27 Oct 1982)

bhajan.title: Sai Ram Sai Shyam Mere Sairam

seva_nudge: Before speaking today, pause once and check: is it true, is it kind, is it necessary?
